en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to us by Sa’d b. Abdillah from Salamah b. al-Khattab from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi from Ali b. Ya’la from Ibrahim b. Muhammad b. Hamran from his father from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
A person who wipes the parts of body after ablution will get a single reward and the person who does not wipe will get thirty rewards.”
